title: Release 0.9.2: version bump, promote, release.yml publish:false for e2e qualification, then publish on the user's approval
description: 0.9.2 ships LCLI-573 (#237, retrieval-first agent guidance). The sequence follows the OPAG-378 05:15Z orchestrator ruling and opum-cli-e2e's 2026-09-24 request. (1) Bump to 0.9.2 on dev as one version-metadata commit, the same recipe as #234. (2) Promote to main. (3) Dispatch release.yml with publish:false at that SHA and send the run id to opum-cli-e2e. (4) e2e qualifies those exact npm-packages tarballs and sends a receipt with the SHA, the run id and each tarball's sha256. (5) Publishing those bytes is the user's decision. (6) After publish, give opum-marketplace the tag, the tag object, the peeled commit and the skills/ tree SHA, in two messages (LCLI-469). LCLI-575 does not land on dev until the bump is cut, so the qualified SHA stays the release SHA.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Bump commit on dev covers every version site #234 touched, with bun test, typecheck, lint and bun run lore check green on its PR run
dev promoted to main at the bump SHA as a fast-forward
release.yml run with publish:false at that SHA is green; run id sent to opum-cli-e2e
opum-cli-e2e qualification receipt received and recorded here (SHA, run id, tarball digests)
Publication decided by the user; if published, registry latest=0.9.2 on all seven packages and marketplace handshake sent

implementationNotes: Progress 2026-09-24. AC1: bump #242. The PR run on its head was green, and the promotion PR #244 check-runs on 71f2c1e4 were all green except promotion-is-manual (red by design). AC2: main fast-forwarded ecb9748c->71f2c1e470aac36465871652ddf5347d5b0382c0 by git push origin origin/dev:main, trees equal to origin/dev, and #244 auto-marked MERGED. AC3: release.yml run 35961511364 (workflow_dispatch, publish=false, head 71f2c1e4) succeeded. All six matching-host package qualifications and the package+install-sanity dry-run were green; publish was skipped. Artifacts expire 2026-12-23. Run id and my own npm-packages sha256s were sent to opum-cli-e2e [38f3f1]: root f45bac6c...0fc794, darwin-arm64 9ed2f118...afd11b, darwin-x64 cff7722d...d0cb6, linux-arm64 981903b1...0cd8f, linux-x64 cd97641f...6ef69, win32-arm64 a3919688...7ccd, win32-x64 54a3ee19...8b614. Publication path: scripts/publish-release.sh 0.9.2 35961511364, which re-verifies each sha256 before publishing (no rebuild). Waiting on e2e's receipt (AC4), then the user's decision (AC5).

AC4: opum-cli-e2e receipt received 2026-09-24. QUALIFIED FOR PUBLICATION, run 35961511364 at 71f2c1e4, paired with quest 0.9.0: 463 rows, 461 PASS / 0 FAIL / 2 BLOCKED (both pre-publish by construction), 0 rows moved by #237. All 7 tarball sha256s equal mine. AC5: the user approved via AskUserQuestion. Published by scripts/publish-release.sh 0.9.2 35961511364 (the dry run first verified 6/6 against the CI digests; root self-seal f45bac6c matches e2e's digest). --verify-only shows all seven present with latest=0.9.2. npm pack of all seven from the registry: sha256 equal to the receipt, 7/7. Tag v0.9.2 = object ed4153be, peels to 71f2c1e4. GitHub Release created. The npm readme passes shipped-readme-version --check. Handshake sent to opum-marketplace [84c93b] (tag, object, commit, skills tree ce580cd1); opum-cli-e2e and quest-cli told. No provenance (LCLI-482). Release truth is in docs/reference/lore-cli-release-truth.md in this PR.
finalSummary: 0.9.2 released: qualified by opum-cli-e2e before publication on the exact bytes that shipped (run 35961511364, 7/7 sha256 match registry to receipt), published on the user's approval, tag v0.9.2 -> 71f2c1e4, marketplace handshake sent. Evidence is in the LCLI-577 notes and lore-cli-release-truth.md.
